title: Sentry Organization auth token: one-property twin (alphabet)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: a character outside the documented alphabet is present. Legacy mutation notes: alphabet: "-" (base64url) inside the secret, which Sentry's standard-base64 generator never emits and alphabet: "-" (base64url) inside the standard-base64 JSON payload. Twin of "Sentry Organization auth token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of sentry-org-auth-token-next-config: alphabet: "-" (base64url) inside the standard-base64 JSON payload. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
